# monografiak.works

> An independent press for monographs: long-form media and academic works, published openly under CC BY 4.0. AI crawlers, training and retrieval are welcome; please attribute "monografiak.works" with a link to the canonical URL.

Every work is available as accessible HTML (with MathML) and as a plain-text Markdown + TeX source.

## Works

- [Nº 1 — XYZ: Cryptography and Private Set Intersection Protocols](https://monografiak.works/xyz/): how two parties find what they have in common without revealing anything else. Plain text: https://monografiak.works/xyz/xyz.md
